"""Capture one explicitly authorized Fee C1 check; no source or Git mutations."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--tag", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--cwd", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-manifest", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--window-record", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    manifest_path = Path(args.source_manifest).resolve()
    window_path = Path(args.window_record).resolve()
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    window = json.loads(window_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if window.get("owner") != "a-share-usability" or window.get("status") != "returned":
        raise RuntimeError("An explicit returned shared-window record is required")
    command = args.command[1:] if args.command[:1] == ["--"] else args.command
    if not command or not args.tag.replace("-", "").isalnum():
        raise ValueError("Use one explicit command and an alphanumeric/hyphen tag")
    output = root / ".tmp" / f"ash-c1-{args.tag}.json"
    log = output.with_suffix(".log")
    if output.exists() or log.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Prior command results are immutable; use a new tag")
    sources = {row["path"]: row["raw_sha256"] for row in manifest["files"]}

    def verify() -> None:
        for relative, expected in sources.items():
            path = (root / relative).resolve()
            if not path.is_relative_to(root) or digest(path) != expected:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Source drift: {relative}")

    verify()
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONUTF8="1", PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8", PYTEST_ADDOPTS="")
    env.update(manifest.get("environment", {}))
    started = time.monotonic()
    with log.open("xb") as stream:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=args.cwd, env=env, stdout=stream,
                                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)
    record = {
        "phase": args.tag, "command": command, "cwd": args.cwd,
        "exit_code": result.returncode, "seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
        "source_manifest": str(manifest_path), "source_manifest_raw_sha256": digest(manifest_path),
        "window_record_raw_sha256": digest(window_path), "driver_raw_sha256": digest(Path(__file__)),
        "log": str(log), "log_raw_sha256": digest(log), "sources": sources,
    }
    output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    verify()
    print(json.dumps(record, indent=2), flush=True)
    return result.returncode


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
